items.lede: X (and Twitter before it) have never really had real parental controls. Until now.
items.title: X is adding its first-ever parental controls

items.lede: X is finally rolling out parental controls that allow parents and guardians to manage teens' accounts on the platform. While teens will retain ownership of their own account, parents and guardians will be able to see how much time their child has spent on X, set daily limits, require approval for new followers, and limit […]
items.title: X is finally getting its first parental controls

items.lede: Elon Musk's social network X has finally added parental controls for teenagers, giving parents and guardians a way to manage what their kids see on the platform.
items.title: X finally gets parental controls after 20 years
